description: Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council - The Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Appropriation Statute No. 04 of 2016 come into Operation of the date of receiving the assent of the Governor
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the enactment of the "Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No. 04 of 2016" by the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council. It contains detailed financial legislation including appropriation authorizations, expenditure limits, revenue provisions, and statutory procedures for budget management. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves the creation and amendment of provincial laws and regulations governing financial matters.
